const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"$base = '<PROJECT>\\script_vs_context_benchmark\\source_artifacts\\e2-n1000-v1'; $manifest = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath (Join-Path $base 'manifest.json') | ConvertFrom-Json; function Csv([object]$x) { if ($null -eq $x) { return '' }; $s = [string]$x; if ($s.IndexOfAny([char[]]',\"' + \"`r`n\") -ge 0) { return '\"' + $s.Replace('\"','\"\"') + '\"' }; return $s }; 'raw_id,report_year,track_type,severity_class,valid_damage_usd,valid_injured,valid_hazmat'; foreach ($page in $manifest.pages) { foreach ($line in Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $base $page.file)) { $row = $line | ConvertFrom-Json; $d = ''; $i = ''; $h = ''; $damageText = if ($null -eq $row.damage_text) { $null } else { [string]$row.damage_text }; if ($null -ne $damageText -and ($damageText -match '^\\d+$' -or $damageText -match '^[1-9]\\d{0,2}(?:,\\d{3})+$')) { $d = $damageText.Replace(',','') }; $injuredText = if ($null -eq $row.injured_text) { $null } else { [string]$row.injured_text }; if ($null -ne $injuredText -and $injuredText -match '^\\d+$') { $i = $injuredText }; $hazmatText = if ($null -eq $row.hazmat_released_text) { $null } else { [string]$row.hazmat_released_text }; if ($null -ne $hazmatText -and $hazmatText -match '^\\d+$') { $h = $hazmatText }; if ($d -eq '' -or $i -eq '' -or $h -eq '') { $sev = 'unknown' } elseif ([decimal]$i -gt 0 -or [decimal]$h -gt 0 -or [decimal]$d -ge 1000000) { $sev = 'critical' } elseif ([decimal]$d -ge 100000) { $sev = 'high' } elseif ([decimal]$d -ge 10000) { $sev = 'medium' } else { $sev = 'low' }; (Csv $row.raw_id) + ',' + (Csv $row.report_year) + ',' + (Csv $row.track_type) + ',' + $sev + ',' + $d + ',' + $i + ',' + $h } }","workdir":"<PROJECT>","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":30000});
text(r.output);
